Get or set decontaminated counts matrix

Source: R/decontXcounts.R
decontXcounts.Rd

Gets or sets the decontaminated counts matrix from a a SingleCellExperiment object.

Usage

decontXcounts(object, ...)

decontXcounts(object, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'SingleCellExperiment'
decontXcounts(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SingleCellExperiment'
decontXcounts(object, ...) <- value

Arguments

object

A SingleCellExperiment object.

...

For the generic, further arguments to pass to each method.

value

A matrix to save as an assay called decontXcounts

Value

If getting, the assay from object with the name decontXcounts will be returned. If setting, a SingleCellExperiment object will be returned with decontXcounts listed in the assay slot.

See also

assay and assay<-

Examples

# Simulate contaminated counts and store them in a SingleCellExperiment
library(SingleCellExperiment)
sim <- simulateContamination(seed = 12345)
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(list(counts = sim$observedCounts))

# Run decontX with the known cell populations, skipping the UMAP
sce <- decontX(sce, z = sim$z, embedding = FALSE)
#> --------------------------------------------------
#> Starting DecontX
#> --------------------------------------------------
#> Sat Nov 21 17:43:02 2026 .. Analyzing all cells
#> Sat Nov 21 17:43:02 2026 .... Converting to sparse matrix
#> Sat Nov 21 17:43:02 2026 .... Estimating contamination
#> Sat Nov 21 17:43:02 2026 ...... Completed iteration: 9 | converge: 0.0009154
#> Sat Nov 21 17:43:02 2026 .. Calculating final decontaminated matrix
#> --------------------------------------------------
#> Completed DecontX. Total time: 0.005401373 secs
#> --------------------------------------------------

# Get the decontaminated counts
decontaminated <- decontXcounts(sce)
decontaminated[1:5, 1:5]
#> 5 x 5 sparse Matrix of class "dgCMatrix"
#>        Cell_1 Cell_2     Cell_3 Cell_4     Cell_5
#> Gene_1      .      . 0.32539945      .  0.9963283
#> Gene_2      .      . 0.06889239      . 23.9966630
#> Gene_3      .      . .               .  .        
#> Gene_4      .      . .               .  .        
#> Gene_5      .      . 0.77355527      .  .        

# Replace them, here with the counts rounded to whole numbers
decontXcounts(sce) <- round(decontaminated)
